The '''Byss and Abyss system''', alternatively known as the '''Abyss system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Ash Worlds]] sector in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Byss (Abyssin)/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
